entries.scope: Six stable MSL host toolchains, bounded maintenance, shared PowerShell policy, package registries, user launchers and structured evidence
entries.rationale: An installed or executable package does not establish current active language tooling. Operators need stable release sources, bounded update commands, source-lag behavior and explicit host versus project boundaries.
readerPaths: Maintenance overview -> bounded MSL preview -> version report
Maintainer guidance -> CLI/package registries -> native host evidence
entries.navigationImpact: Adds a focused bilingual MSL reference linked from existing maintenance entries and platform manpages. Generated script reference includes internal PowerShell helpers.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second in shared reference, manpages and guidance; synchronized maintenance overview language partners.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Native Mac A installation and fresh-shell probes are recorded separately from portable Windows/Linux fixtures. Preview and comparison do not install packages or alter user profiles.
entries.risk: Rolling host major versions can differ from project pins; package-source lag remains required drift. A Mac run and portable tests do not establish native Windows/Linux installation or downstream project acceptance.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Upstream release APIs, stable release policy, package identifiers, supported platforms, Swiftly activation or result contract changes.
